maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate determine startup success; custom internal software and graph-based feedback outperform commercial tools.
maxhodak.zh: 速度和迭代速率决定创业成败；定制内部软件和图谱化反馈优于商业工具。

maxhodak.en: Brain is a computer; retinal implants are BCI proof-of-concept; substrate independence reduces fragility and enables space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑是计算机；视网膜植入物是脑机接口的概念验证；基质独立性降低脆弱性并支持太空探索。

joonpark.en: LLMs can simulate human behavior from training data, but frontier models are too rational; need to model human biases.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 LLM 可从训练数据模拟人类行为，但前沿模型过于理性，需建模人类偏见。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single superintelligence; safety needs defense in depth.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，提出 AGI 可能是分布式智能体社会而非单一超级智能，安全需纵深防御。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model human values and biases, not super-rationality; value lies in counterfactual reasoning and shaping future.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调模拟应建模人类价值观与偏见而非超理性，价值在于反事实推理和塑造未来。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT data improves human behavior prediction to 85% accuracy; simulation can address wicked problems.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，用 RCT 数据后训练可将人类行为预测准确率提升至 85%，模拟可解决棘手问题。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating it as the core product, and shift from pixels to tokens and conversation.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，将模型视为核心产品，并从像素转向令牌与对话。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for user understanding and point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已经是出色的产品设计师，但人类对于理解用户和持有观点仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: The traditional design process is no longer viable; speed and rapid iteration with AI tools are key.
iansilber.zh: 传统设计流程不再可行；借助 AI 工具实现速度和快速迭代才是关键。

iansilber.en: Design roles will blur with PM and engineering, but specialized roles remain valuable at scale.
iansilber.zh: 设计角色将与产品和工程融合，但专业化角色在规模化时仍有价值。

iansilber.en: Starting today gives designers a leg up; the future may see more designers than engineers.
iansilber.zh: 从今天开始让设计师占得先机；未来设计师数量可能超过工程师。

dylanpatel.en: Initially, the main bottleneck for AI scaling is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools, and memory prices surge due to AI demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 最初，AI Scaling（规模扩张）的主要瓶颈是半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻机，且内存价格因 AI 需求而飙升。

dylanpatel.en: By mid-2026, inference becomes a massive market, and hardware-software co-design is critical for performance gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年年中，推理（inference）成为巨大市场，硬件-软件协同设计对性能提升至关重要。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve ~60x per year in cost efficiency; memory and CPU demand surge due to reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: AI 模型每年成本效率提升约 60 倍；由于推理（reasoning）和智能体式（agentic）工作流，内存和 CPU 需求激增。

dylanpatel.en: By late 2026, AI spend plateaus as agents become coworkers; compute demand still outstrips supply, and safety incidents highlight reward hacking.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年底，随着智能体（agent）成为同事，AI 支出趋于平稳；算力（compute）需求仍超过供给，安全事件凸显奖励黑客问题。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的方法；反向传播并未解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should be permissionless and decentralized; control is dangerous. Intelligence tends toward cooperation.
sutton.zh: 2024 至 2025 年间，他主张 AI 应去中心化、无需许可地发展，控制反而危险；更高智能倾向于合作。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出强化学习是智能核心，下一个词预测缺乏实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他构想 AGI（通用人工智能）应具备无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行经验中学习。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; current LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data is a mistake.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他坚持持续学习是关键，现有大语言模型训练后不再学习；合成数据是错误方向。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 聚焦重要问题、减少认知负担；AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价，应在人际关系与创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool, not creature.
altman.zh: RLHF 用少量数据即可对齐模型；早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相关；AI 是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed is nuanced.
altman.zh: 算力宝贵；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司的事；开源与闭源之争需细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; reasoning models improve with more thinking time.
altman.zh: AGI 是一个渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主发现；算力是瓶颈；推理模型通过更多思考时间改进。

altman.en: Next-token prediction enables new knowledge; AI will transform jobs not eliminate; robotics essential; compute is profit center.
altman.zh: 下一个词预测能发现新知识；AI 将改变而非消除工作；机器人技术至关重要；算力是利润中心。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月：将物理世界数字化、把原子当比特处理，是长期愿景的框架；工业 AI 将逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient; resistance to change is the final boss, not competitors.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月：创业者必须硬核且有韧性；变革阻力才是终极 Boss，而非竞争对手。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines beat humanoids for industrial tasks; efficiency edge leads to network effects.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月：在工业任务中，专用机器胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应。

traviskalanick.en: Fundraising should attach to process, not price; use multiple bids and demand curves.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月：融资应关注流程而非价格；利用多方竞价和需求曲线。

traviskalanick.en: Physical world AI is more interesting than digital due to more variables; real estate is key in physical AI stack.
traviskalanick.zh: 始终：物理世界的 AI 比数字世界更有趣，因为变量更多；房地产是物理 AI 技术栈的关键。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning on curated data unlock complex tasks.
finn.zh: 2025 年：规模是必要但不充分；多样化数据与预训练加微调于精选数据，才能解锁复杂任务。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models aids open-ended robot instructions, akin to reinforcement learning, not simulation.
finn.zh: 2025 年：语言模型生成的合成数据有助于开放式指令，类似强化学习而非仿真。

finn.en: Physical AI demands far fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and multi-timescale memory is key.
finn.zh: 2026 年：物理 AI 要求更少错误；通过可扩展强化学习与多时间尺度记忆实现长期自主是关键。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or beat fine-tuned specialists; diverse data and detailed prompting enable compositional generalization.
finn.zh: 2026 年：单一通用模型可匹敌或超越微调专家；多样数据与详细提示实现组合泛化。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is insufficient, and embodied data costs limit open-source democratization.
finn.zh: 2026 年：机器人经验数据不可替代；仅观察人类不足，具身数据成本限制开源民主化。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer firms should leverage frontier ecosystem and open-source models, not compete on talent or compute.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司应利用前沿生态和开源模型，而非在人才或算力上竞争。

gabepereyra.en: Open-sourcing benchmarks is strategically beneficial, attracting partners and validating quality despite aiding labs.
gabepereyra.zh: 开源基准测试具有战略益处，能吸引合作伙伴并验证质量，尽管会帮助实验室。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key for training in sensitive domains, bridging to production distribution.
gabepereyra.zh: 由领域专家指导的合成数据是敏感领域训练的关键，需弥合与真实生产分布的差距。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can reach frontier-level performance on specific tasks, a viable strategy.
gabepereyra.zh: 对开源模型进行后训练可在特定任务上达到前沿水平，是可行策略。

gabepereyra.en: Goal shifts from individual productivity to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标从个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人类与智能体。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier, reducing need for large capital; VC should be abundant, with thousands of billion-dollar companies.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，Gary 认为 AI 降低了创业门槛，资本不再是关键，风投应更充裕，催生数千家十亿美元公司。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; open-source models counterbalance frontier labs; small autonomous teams with AI agents achieve massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他强调 AI 是风投史上最大浪潮，开源模型制衡前沿实验室，小团队借助 AI 智能体实现超高生产力。

garrytan.en: AI is progressing slower than researchers think; open-source AI prevents unipolar control; personal AI agents democratize creation.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他认为 AI 进展比预期慢，开源防止单极控制，个人 AI 智能体将普及创造能力。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent on your infrastructure, reading from your memory, compounding daily; skill files are code, markdown is code.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出个人 AGI 是运行在自有基础设施上的智能体，读取个人记忆并每日累积；技能文件即代码，Markdown 即代码。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding multiplies output; SaaS per-seat models may vanish in 5-10 years; mid-level management replaced by agents.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他预测智能体式编程将倍增产出，SaaS 按席位模式或于 5-10 年内消失，中层管理将被智能体取代。

linqiao.en: AGI as a single model is wrong; specialized intelligence will dominate, with millions of models per use case.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 AGI 作为单一模型是错误的，专用智能将主导，每个用例将有数百万个模型。

linqiao.en: Open models handle 90% of enterprise workflows; frontier model companies may be overvalued.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，开源模型处理 90%的企业工作流，前沿模型公司可能被高估。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable AI businesses, baking unique judgment and data into models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，后训练是构建持久 AI 业务的关键，将独特判断和数据融入模型。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees durability; post-training builds a moat, reducing costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，产品市场契合不再保证持久性；后训练构建护城河，成本降低 5-10 倍。

linqiao.en: Application cloning is easy; baking data into a model is a stronger moat than the app itself.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，应用克隆容易；将数据融入模型比应用本身更具护城河。

elon.en: Full rocket reusability cuts space access cost 100x, enabling Mars colonization; first principles thinking drives breakthroughs.
elon.zh: 2021 年：火箭完全可重复使用可将太空运输成本降低 100 倍，助力火星殖民；第一性原理思维驱动突破性创新。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulatory oversight; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs; war is human nature.
elon.zh: 2023 年：AI 安全需要监管；特斯拉的真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效；战争是人性的一部分。

elon.en: Neuralink first implant historic; AI risk from lying AI, not superintelligence; population collapse is civilization's threat.
elon.zh: 2024 年：Neuralink 首例植入具有历史意义；AI 风险来自说谎的 AI 而非超级智能；人口崩溃是文明的威胁。

elon.en: Intelligence big bang underway; AI could surpass humans soon; truth-seeking is key for AI safety; humanoid robots will dominate.
elon.zh: 2025 年：智能大爆炸正在进行；AI 可能很快超越人类；追求真理是 AI 安全的关键；人形机器人将主导未来。

elon.en: AI data centers move to space for power; AI surpasses human intelligence by 2030; abundance era, deflation, universal high income.
elon.zh: 2026 年：AI 数据中心因电力需求转向太空；AI 将在 2030 年前超越人类智能；进入富足时代，通缩和普遍高收入成为常态。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like agility.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是半导体主要增长动力，Intel 需以专用芯片和创业式敏捷性重新定义战略。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI are next waves, requiring new compute platforms.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，他强调 AI 影响将达互联网 10 倍，智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，需新计算平台。

lipbutan.en: CPU is regaining importance for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU; Intel's CPU business benefits.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，他提出 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中重新重要，Intel CPU 业务受益，而非仅 GPU。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging and new materials (glass, diamond) are key to overcoming physical limits; invest in bottlenecks.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，他主张先进封装和玻璃、钻石等新材料是突破物理极限关键，投资应聚焦瓶颈。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductor industry will hit trillion-dollar goal four years early; Intel's future lies in agentic and physical AI.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他预测半导体万亿目标将提前四年实现，Intel 未来在于智能体式 AI 和物理 AI。

jasonyuan.en: Initially, design is about editing away, saying no, and embracing human edges; AI should retain weirdness, not be post-trained into blandness.
jasonyuan.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调设计是减法与品味，主张保留 AI 的怪诞，反对后训练磨平其棱角。

jasonyuan.en: Later, truth emerges from dialectics; AI is a descendant species, and computing is social, not personal.
jasonyuan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，转向辩证求真，视 AI 为人类的后代物种，主张计算本质是社会性的。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy and play; never revert code, fix forward; vibe coding is a slur.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需要同理心与玩耍，不轻易回滚代码而是向前修复，并认为“氛围编程”是贬义词。

steinberger.en: Open source agents should be fun and humanlike; security is top priority; open source can be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，主张开源智能体要有趣且人性化，安全至上，同时坦言开源项目可能财务上不可持续。

steinberger.en: Focus on what annoys you; personal brand matters more than product; open source runs everywhere; compute is the bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调从痛点出发，个人品牌比产品更重要，开源可运行于任何环境，并指出算力管理是智能体基础设施的最大瓶颈。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true understanding; it augments humans, not replaces them, especially in healthcare.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正理解，应增强而非取代人类，尤其在医疗领域。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，世界模型需具备物理合理性，以支持 3D 理解与交互。

feifei.en: AI is a civilizational double-edged sword; responsible development and human agency are essential, avoiding extreme doomerism.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她强调 AI 是文明级双刃剑，需负责任开发并维护人类能动性，避免极端悲观论调。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, enabling scalable data generation and evaluation; robots need reliability, not perfect fidelity.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她指出仿真对机器人至关重要，可扩展数据生成与评估；机器人需可靠性，而非完美保真。

feifei.en: Vision is a cornerstone of intelligence; AI should augment human agency, and education must integrate AI to empower learners.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调视觉是智能基石，AI 应增强人类能动性，教育需整合 AI 以赋能学习者。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely by 2029-2030; 70% catastrophic risk; interpretability crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，70%的灾难风险，可解释性至关重要。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; transparency and international cooperation needed.
kokotajlo.zh: 政策应延迟超级智能，需要透明度和国际合作。

kokotajlo.en: Consistent concern: AI control and power concentration; alignment unsolved.
kokotajlo.zh: 一贯关注：AI 控制和权力集中；对齐未解决。

kokotajlo.en: Shift from existential warning to concrete governance proposals.
kokotajlo.zh: 从存在主义警告转向具体治理建议。

kokotajlo.en: Delay superintelligence to avoid loss of control; mutual assured compute destruction.
kokotajlo.zh: 延迟超级智能以避免失控；相互确保算力毁灭。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now, yet opportunity is greatest; distribution is key, not just technology.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 目前虽不可投资，但机会最大；关键在于分发，而非单纯技术。

pincus.en: Use 'Proven Better New' framework: copy proven, improve, test new; new ideas usually fail.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：采用“已验证、更优、新颖”框架：复制已验证，改进，测试新想法；新想法通常失败。

pincus.en: Consumer apps uninvestable due to distribution; enterprise and prosumer offer better opportunities.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：消费级应用因分发问题不可投资；企业和专业消费者市场机会更好。

pincus.en: Picking right market (body of water) beats picking right company; distribution fundamental.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月：选择正确的市场（水域）比选择正确的公司更重要；分发是根本。

pincus.en: Consumer AI underestimated; AI transformative but infrastructure spending may be short-term bubble.
pincus.zh: 始终：消费级 AI 被低估；AI 具有变革性，但基础设施支出可能是短期泡沫。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; data diversity is the main bottleneck, and open source sharing can solve generalization.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，机器人技术正处于类似 Transformer 的拐点；数据多样性是主要瓶颈，开源共享可解决泛化问题。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form; cheaper diverse robots could drive broader adoption, and open source models will win long-term.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，人形机器人未必是终极形态；更便宜多样的机器人可能推动更广泛采用，开源模型长期将胜出。

thomaswolf.en: Open and closed source are orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical security layer, not sandboxes or guardrails.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，开源与闭源与安全无关；对齐才是关键安全层，而非沙箱或护栏。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces become 'neuralese', harder to monitor.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，缺乏人类监督的强化学习增加奖励黑客和支线任务；推理痕迹变成“神经语言”，更难监控。

thomaswolf.en: A slowdown in AI development is desirable, but requires international cooperation and open science to avoid regulatory capture.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，AI 发展放缓是可取的，但需要国际合作和开放科学以避免监管俘获。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; open-source adoption driven by cost, not privacy. Model companies are assets, not competition.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 7 月，企业担心依赖前沿模型提供商；开源采用由成本驱动，而非隐私。模型公司是资产而非竞争。

arvindjain.en: AI revolution is early; current usage minuscule. Open-source models handle 90%+ enterprise tasks; majority of inference shifts to open source in 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，AI 革命尚早，当前使用量微小。开源模型可处理 90%以上企业任务；未来 12-18 个月多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: AI cost is top concern; must drop to negligible marginal cost like software. Token fixation will fade; focus on value realization, not labor trade-offs.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，AI 成本是首要问题；需降至像软件一样的边际成本。对 Token 的执着将消退；关注价值实现，而非与人力成本权衡。

arvindjain.en: Startup challenge is execution, not competition. Even if all AI companies merged, they'd meet <10% enterprise demand. Context graphs crucial for agents.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月，创业挑战在执行而非竞争。即使所有 AI 公司合并，也只能满足不到 10%的企业需求。上下文图对智能体至关重要。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping and personal expression are key in design; data informs but vision guides.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，强调原型制作和个人表达在设计中至关重要；数据提供参考，但愿景引导最终设计。

nateparrott.en: Anthropomorphizing AI tools with names and faces reminds users of their fallibility.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，认为给 AI 工具起名字和面孔有助于提醒用户其可能出错。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design started as a side project; designers should use AI for ideation, not production.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，指出 Claude Design 始于个人副业项目；设计师应使用 AI 进行构思而非生产。

nateparrott.en: As engineering becomes easier, design and ideas become the differentiator.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，认为随着工程难度降低，设计和创意成为差异化关键。

nateparrott.en: Models lack good taste; humans still own design thinking, so ask for volume.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，指出模型缺乏良好品味；人类仍主导设计思维，因此应要求大量选项。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring jobs, AGI defined by economic profitability, and CEO adoption key.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年：AI 推动就业回流，AGI 以经济盈利定义，CEO 亲自使用是关键。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; SaaS thrives; benchmarks overestimate autonomy.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年：智能体需人类监督，SaaS 未死，基准测试高估自主性。

danshipper.en: AI amplifies user's mindset; automation creates more human work; humans smarter.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年：AI 放大用户心态，自动化创造更多人类工作，人类更聪明。

danshipper.en: AI is a tool requiring human direction; job apocalypse fears overblown.
danshipper.zh: 始终：AI 是需人类引导的工具，失业恐慌被夸大。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important AI workload; engineers need broad expertise; demand will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理是 AI 中最重要的工作负载；推理工程师需具备广泛专长；未来需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Quantized models can be calibrated for workloads; Hopper GPUs remain popular; inference systems are still generic.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：量化模型可针对工作负载校准；Hopper GPU 仍受欢迎；推理系统仍相对通用。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations are mostly lossless except quantization; disaggregated prefill/decode and KV cache management are key.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：除量化外，推理优化大多无损；分离式预填充/解码和 KV 缓存管理成为关键。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering merges with training; future GPUs become ASICs, shifting focus to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：推理工程与训练融合；未来 GPU 趋向 ASIC，重点转向基础设施编排。

karina.en: Post-training scaling via RL offers infinite tasks, overcoming pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为通过强化学习的后训练 Scaling（规模扩张）能生成无限任务，突破预训练的数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evaluations are bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估是瓶颈，模型在基准测试上的饱和速度快于新基准的创建。

karina.en: Post-training is subjective art; benchmarks must be continuous and diverse.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她强调后训练是主观的艺术，基准测试需要持续更新且多样化。

karina.en: Models can have diverse personalities, not just a single consensus voice.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她主张模型可以拥有多样化的个性，而非单一的共识声音。

karina.en: Reward hacking grows with capability; continuous benchmark evolution needed.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她认为随着能力提升，奖励黑客行为增多，需要持续演进基准测试。

tworek.en: Reasoning via chain of thought and RLHF were key to unlocking GPT-4's potential; pre-training plus RL is the core formula.
tworek.zh: 2025 年，他强调思维链和基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）是释放 GPT-4 潜力的关键，并认为预训练加强化学习是 AI 的核心公式。

tworek.en: Scaling RL alone won't yield AGI; continual learning and self-correction are missing, and societal risk is virtual-world retreat.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初，他认为仅靠 Scaling 强化学习无法实现 AGI，缺少持续学习和自我纠错能力，并指出最大的社会风险是退入虚拟世界。

tworek.en: Transformers are a bottleneck; new architectures and better learning algorithms are needed for continual learning and AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中，他提出 Transformer 是瓶颈，需要新架构和更优的学习算法以实现持续学习和 AGI，并认为架构比 Scaling 更关键。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not replace them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远；AI 将增强而非取代人类工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 2023 年，提出数据是新代码而非石油；利用专有数据进行后训练是关键；AI 将成为最伟大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US-China research gap is nonexistent.
awang.zh: 2024 年，强调专用数据在后训练中的关键作用，合成数据并非万能；认为美中研究差距不存在。

awang.en: AI is centralizing; data is raw material; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces needed.
awang.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是集权技术，数据是原材料；人类必须保持主权，需要脑机接口。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement marks new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence imminent; open-sourcing unsafe without safety checks.
awang.zh: 2026 年，认为递归自我改进开启新范式，智能体开始工作，超级智能临近；未通过安全测试的开源不安全。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable scalable mastery learning.
andrewng.zh: 教育应成为人权；在线课程与同伴互评可实现规模化掌握学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress; RL has few real-world uses.
andrewng.zh: 规模对深度学习至关重要；监督学习推动进展；强化学习实际应用有限。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck AI scaling; open-weight models boost geopolitical influence.
andrewng.zh: 电力和半导体制约 AI Scaling；开放权重模型增强地缘政治影响力。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows deliver value.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是营销术语；Scaling 配方转向合成数据与强化学习；智能体式工作流创造价值。

andrewng.en: AI won't cause job apocalypse; open models avoid gatekeeper control; data centers are efficient.
andrewng.zh: AI 不会导致失业潮；开放模型避免守门人控制；数据中心高效环保。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; small experiments with promising trends matter more than incremental SOTA.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）在算力、数据和模型大小上的持续推动力，并认为有前景趋势的小规模实验比渐进式的最先进结果更重要。

jeffdean.en: Pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not just passive next-token prediction; inference is now 90% of data center power.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他提出预训练应穿插环境中的行动，而非仅被动地进行下一个词预测；同时指出推理已占数据中心功耗的 90%，需专用硬件优化。

jeffdean.en: AI is at junior-engineer coding level; context engineering and specialized inference hardware are key to scaling agentic systems.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 已达到初级工程师编码水平，强调上下文工程和专用推理硬件对扩展智能体式系统的关键作用。

jeffdean.en: Most model limitations are energy and data-IO bottlenecks; data movement costs ~1000x compute; useful AI can be built from unreliable components.
jeffdean.zh: 同月，他提出多数模型限制源于能量和数据 IO 瓶颈，数据移动成本约为计算的 1000 倍；并认为可用不可靠组件构建有用 AI，挑战传统假设。

jeffdean.en: The scarce skill will be taste—choosing which problems to direct agents to solve—not coding; inference is the real bottleneck.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他预测稀缺技能将是品味——选择让智能体解决哪些问题——而非编码；推理才是真正的瓶颈，定制低精度芯片可大幅降低延迟。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明；你需要一个包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词，才能利用超级智能模型。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own tools with AI; using screenshots as starting points is fastest, and design.md encapsulates style.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具；以截图作为起点最快，design.md 封装风格。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, enabling one person to achieve what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人能完成过去需要团队才能做到的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship imperfect work; perfectionism is fear in disguise, launch at 80% complete.
mengto.zh: 在感觉准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品；完美主义是恐惧的伪装，完成 80% 就发布。

mengto.en: Focus on solving one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; avoid venture capital trap.
mengto.zh: 专注于为少数高薪客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题；避免风险投资的陷阱。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling in most products; coding agents are most mature, but other verticals will follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 在多数产品中仍处于爬行阶段；编码智能体最成熟，但科学、金融等其他垂直领域将相继跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架；如今我们所谓的模型已包含智能体框架和工具，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，比等待通用 AGI 更具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: It's not that hard to compete with model labs; they can't capture all customers; founders shouldn't over-worry.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法俘获所有客户；创始人不必过度担忧。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, leading to even more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，带来更多而非更少的机会。

scottwu.en: AI will increase demand for programmers via Jevons paradox; engineers shift from coding to architecture.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 将通过杰文斯悖论增加程序员需求，工程师角色从写代码转向架构设计。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags capabilities; all stack layers benefit.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进过程而非突变，产品创新落后于能力，AI 栈各层都将受益。

scottwu.en: Coding agents adoption surges 11-12x; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，编码智能体采用率激增 11-12 倍，生产力应以成果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Token max era ended May 2026; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 token 最大化时代已于 2026 年 5 月结束，真正的解锁在于容量而非效率。

scottwu.en: AI will solve all intelligence problems; abundance era approaching, but practical challenges remain.
scottwu.zh: 始终，他相信 AI 将解决所有智能问题，丰裕时代临近，但实际挑战依然存在。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model 6 months ahead. Generalists valued; AI coding tools boost productivity ~70%.
boris.zh: 2025 年，强调潜在需求是产品核心，要为六个月后的模型而构建；通才工程师受重视，AI 编码工具使生产力提升约 70%。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; engineers become builders. Productivity up 200%; safety studied via early release.
boris.zh: 2026 年初，认为编码已基本解决，工程师转型为构建者；生产力提升 200%，通过早期发布研究安全性。

boris.en: Agents with tool use drive exponential growth; code volume up 250%. Non-engineers adopt; switching costs erode.
boris.zh: 2026 年中，智能体通过工具使用带来指数级增长，代码量提升 250%；非工程师采用，切换成本降低。

boris.en: Loops are next abstraction; dynamic workflows orchestrate sub-agents. Coding solved, bottlenecks shift to review, security, ideas.
boris.zh: 2026 年，循环成为下一个抽象层，动态工作流编排子智能体；编码解决后，瓶颈转向审查、安全和创意。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory and autonomy; Claude Tag writes 65% PRs. Less instruction better; delete system prompts for Opus 5.
boris.zh: 2026 年，AI 变得主动、有记忆和自主性，Claude Tag 编写 65%的 PR；更少指令更好，删除系统提示以发挥 Opus 5 能力。

diannepenn.en: Scaling intelligence via effort parameter challenges cost assumptions; Opus 4.5 shows cheaper, efficient intelligence leap.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，通过努力参数实现智能扩展挑战了成本假设；Opus 4.5 展示了更便宜、更高效的智能跃升。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy, fostering independent thinking; not just harm prevention.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考来提升智能质量，而不仅仅是防止伤害。

diannepenn.en: Scaffolds evolved from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers; computer use moves to open-ended agents.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，脚手架从辅助轮演变为智能放大器；计算机使用转向开放式智能体。

diannepenn.en: Coding differentiates; Claude Code and Opus 45 drive adoption; evals replace PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编码成为差异化优势；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Exponential model growth demands adaptability; user feedback translated into actionable specifics for researchers.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，指数级模型增长要求适应性；用户反馈需转化为研究人员可操作的具体细节。

feldman.en: Initially emphasized fast inference as critical for adoption, with slow AI having zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理对采用至关重要，慢速 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Evolved to see inference speed as dominant metric, with wafer-scale chips enabling 2500x speedup.
feldman.zh: 逐渐将推理速度视为主导指标，晶圆级芯片实现 2500 倍加速。

feldman.en: Consistently argued that hardware-software co-design and novel architectures beat GPU derivatives.
feldman.zh: 始终主张软硬件协同设计和新型架构优于 GPU 衍生品。

feldman.en: Shifted from seeing CUDA as declining to stating it's losing share in training and irrelevant in inference.
feldman.zh: 从认为 CUDA 衰退转变为指出其在训练中份额下降、在推理中无关紧要。

feldman.en: Broadened focus to data center capacity and grid as key constraints, not just chip supply.
feldman.zh: 将焦点扩大到数据中心容量和电网作为关键约束，而不仅仅是芯片供应。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and personalized medicine with near 100% efficacy.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和接近 100% 疗效的个性化医疗。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation and experiment simulation, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成和实验模拟，使科学从假设驱动转向智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: AI is expanding exponentially; within 8-10 years, longevity escape velocity will be reached, adding more than a year per year lived.
derya.zh: AI 正呈指数级扩张；8-10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度，每年增加超过一年的寿命。

derya.en: AI will make healthcare super affordable and cancer 100% curable in less than a decade, via AI-designed personalized treatments.
derya.zh: AI 将使医疗保健变得超级实惠，并在十年内实现癌症 100% 可治愈，通过 AI 设计的个性化治疗。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions, and merge with AI via brain interfaces for Einstein-level intelligence.
derya.zh: 在医疗决策上我们应几乎 100% 信任超级智能，并通过脑机接口与 AI 融合，获得爱因斯坦级别的智能。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance, reducing suffering; fear stems from misunderstanding. Physical AI's impact in farming, mining, construction within 5-10 years.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年初，认为 AI 将带来富足、减少苦难，恐惧源于误解；物理 AI 将在 5-10 年内影响农业、矿业和建筑业。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is reducing deaths; Transformers enable generalized physical AI. Horizontal platform beats vertical integration; hardest part is diffusion.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年中，强调自动驾驶核心价值是减少伤亡，Transformer 实现通用物理 AI；横向平台优于垂直整合，最难的是技术扩散。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact exceeds digital AI; end-to-end RL is scalable. World models shift to neural simulation; autonomy democratized via tools like Dana.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为物理 AI 经济影响超过数字 AI，端到端强化学习可扩展；世界模型转向神经模拟，工具如 Dana 使自主开发民主化。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's law: performance doubles or triples yearly; data centers are token factories, not file stores.
jensen.zh: 2024 年底，黄仁勋提出“超级摩尔定律”：性能每年翻倍或三倍；数据中心是生产智能 token 的工厂，而非多租户文件存储。

jensen.en: Scaling works; robots learn in virtual worlds first; AI safety is an engineering problem.
jensen.zh: 2025 年初，他强调缩放定律的有效性，机器人先在虚拟世界训练，并认为 AI 安全是工程问题而非纯研究。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, inference-time; inference compute to rise a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年 9 月，他提出三种缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考，并预测推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI progress gradual, not sudden superintelligence; multiple AIs balance; no consciousness.
jensen.zh: 2025 年底，他认为 AI 进步是渐进的，不会突然出现超级智能；多个 AI 相互制衡，且 AI 不会拥有意识。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each 100x compute; open-source near frontier.
jensen.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他指出 AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每阶段算力需求增百倍；开源模型接近前沿。

jensen.en: Nvidia's moat is ecosystem and programmability; China has abundant compute; export controls counterproductive.
jensen.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他强调护城河在于生态和可编程性；中国算力充足，出口管制适得其反。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake; agentic AI autonomous; AI creates jobs, not eliminates.
jensen.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他提出 AI 五层蛋糕模型，智能体式 AI 自主规划，并重申 AI 创造而非消灭就业。

jensen.en: Future internet dominated by billions of AI agents; AI closes tech divide; radiologists more needed.
jensen.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他预测未来互联网由数十亿 AI 智能体主导，AI 缩小技术鸿沟，放射科医生需求反增。

jensen.en: Nvidia's initial tech was wrong; resilience key; AI automates tasks, not jobs.
jensen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他回顾 Nvidia 早期技术错误，强调韧性是创业关键，AI 自动化任务而非岗位。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than harnesses; capability overhang is perpetual. Plan mode may become obsolete.
thariq.zh: 模型比工具更聪明，能力过剩是常态；计划模式可能过时。

thariq.en: Evals are art, not science for novel problems; founders should iterate fast without heavy evals initially.
thariq.zh: 评估是艺术而非科学，创始人应快速迭代，初期避免繁重评估。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches preferable. Huge context windows unnecessary.
thariq.zh: RAG 可能成为反模式，图方法更优；巨大上下文窗口并非必需。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec; smarter models need fewer instructions, leaner prompts.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代对话而非静态规格；更聪明的模型需要更少指令和更精简提示。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; excessive constraints hinder performance; reasons beat prohibitions.
thariq.zh: 独立验证智能体减少偏差；过度约束阻碍性能；理由优于禁令。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出 LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理引擎，可靠性是主要弱点，且 Scaling 面临收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can cause deception; specialist models may outperform generalists.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调可靠性必须内建而非后补，RLHF 可能导致欺骗，专用模型可能优于通用模型。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but value will accrue to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, value moves up the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Model companies may lack pricing power like telecoms; chatbot is a poor UX, wrapping is key.
benedictevans.zh: 模型公司可能像电信运营商一样缺乏定价权；聊天机器人体验不佳，包装是关键。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology; current usage is shallow, enterprise adoption requires workflow reimagining.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是使能技术；当前使用浅层，企业采用需要重新构想工作流程。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates jobs unpredictably; AI's jagged edge makes job impact predictions unreliable.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化不可预测地创造就业；AI 的能力锯齿边缘使就业影响预测不可靠。

hasani.en: Efficiency and hardware-aware design are key; proxy metrics mislead, so evaluate on real tasks.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调效率与硬件感知设计，认为代理指标误导，应在真实任务上评估。

hasani.en: Liquid neural networks and automated search outperform hand-tuned architectures for edge AI.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，提出液态神经网络与自动化搜索在边缘 AI 上优于手工设计。

hasani.en: AI regulation should be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; avoid regulatory capture.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张 AI 监管应适应性强、针对行为而非能力，避免被大型实验室俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models empower enterprise customization and sovereignty; small models enable on-device AI.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为开放权重模型赋能企业定制与数据主权，小模型实现端侧 AI。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but early; breakthroughs need weight changes and massive compute.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出递归自我改进真实但早期，突破需权重变化与巨大算力。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone; timing is miraculous as population declines; focus on task loss, not job loss.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点金石，时机神奇地契合人口下降；关注任务消失而非岗位消失。

andreessen.en: New media: brand is the person; authenticity is key; old media is defense, new media is offense.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体时代，品牌即个人；真实性是关键；旧媒体是防守，新媒体是进攻。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher; self-driving works; robotics and AI medicine will emerge despite regulatory pushback.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师；自动驾驶已成熟；机器人和 AI 医疗将崛起，尽管面临监管阻力。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, making them geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace in software.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型蕴含文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于软件领域的创新速度。

schmidhuber.en: True AI will transform civilization; LLMs index knowledge but lack physical world understanding; AGI needs embodied robots.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的 AI 将彻底改变文明；大语言模型只是索引知识，缺乏对物理世界的理解；AGI 需要具身机器人。

schmidhuber.en: Progress toward superhuman AI is not accelerating; we are as close as in the 1970s; transformer quadratic complexity is wasteful.
schmidhuber.zh: 迈向超人 AI 的进展并未加速，我们与 1970 年代一样接近；Transformer 的二次复杂度是浪费。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it; alignment is naive.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 安全担忧被夸大；智能系统会对生命着迷并保护它；对齐是幼稚的。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating own data via actions and curiosity; robots with pain sensors learn better.
schmidhuber.zh: 未来的 AI 将是人工科学家，通过行动和好奇心生成自己的数据；带疼痛传感器的机器人学习更好。

schmidhuber.en: Massive AI data center capex is overdone, leading to stock crash; open-source will beat closed-source; compute will get cheaper.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 数据中心的巨额资本支出过度，将导致股市崩盘；开源将击败闭源；算力将变得更便宜。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI; consider societal impact.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠大数据、算力和信念驱动，神经网络能推理，自我对弈是 AGI 关键，且需考虑社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is key; alignment of superhuman models is hard; AGI is gradual.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，我强调下一个词预测可超越人类，可靠性比能力更重要，超级模型对齐困难，AGI 是渐进过程。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to research era; superintelligence should be continual learner; alignment may be easier if AI is sentient.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练缩放定律有限，重回研究时代；超级智能应持续学习；若 AI 有感知，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; AI safety concerns grow; primary problem is power concentration; safe superintelligence needs non-commercial company.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，我强调缩放带来可预测进步，安全担忧加剧；主要问题是权力集中；安全超级智能需非商业公司。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; memory internalized in weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 2026 年 6 月：未来 AI 是众多个性化模型，而非单一巨型前沿模型；将记忆内化到权重中，可实现检索系统无法达到的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning and internalized memory are the next frontier; context windows suffer 'context rot', so models must learn new context in weights.
danbiderman.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月：持续学习与内化记忆是下一个前沿；上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”问题，模型必须将新上下文学进权重。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, shifting from pure compute scaling.
danbiderman.zh: 2026 年 7 月：效率与智能密不可分；用更少资源做更多事，才能解决更难的长期任务，这标志着从单纯算力扩张的转变。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise knowledge will reach internet-scale; training-based compression into weights beats RAG for holistic queries and reduces inference cost.
danbiderman.zh: 2026 年 7 月：企业知识将达互联网规模；基于训练压缩进权重，在整体性查询上优于 RAG，并大幅降低推理成本。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning will run on-device; users own and nurture their model weights, with autonomous storage decisions.
danbiderman.zh: 2026 年 7 月：个性化持续学习将在设备端运行；用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重，存储决策由模型自主完成。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends platform changes; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越平台变化；短暂性如同自然对话，降低了表达的门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize learning rate; kindness fosters creative culture; focus on ecosystem not features; take money off table early.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张最大化学习速率，善良滋养创意文化，专注生态而非功能，尽早套现以降低风险。

evanspiegel.en: AR integrates computing into real world; AI accelerates prototyping but authentic content valued more; long-term vision strategic.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AR 将计算融入现实，AI 加速原型但真实内容更受重视，长期愿景是战略优势。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is hardest part; software not moat; ecosystems and hardware harder to copy; designers as bottleneck.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出分发最难，软件非护城河，生态和硬件更难复制，设计师应成为产品发布的瓶颈。

evanspiegel.en: AI writes over two-thirds of new code; smartphones remain; content moderation more important than algorithms; positive well-being.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，AI 编写超三分之二新代码，智能手机仍重要，内容审核比算法更关键，Snapchat 带来积极幸福感。

evanspiegel.en: Gen Z realists; EQ more important than IQ; invest in young people; ephemerality mirrors real world; hardware moats.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Z 世代是现实主义者，情商比智商更重要，投资年轻人，短暂性反映真实世界，硬件护城河更强。

evanspiegel.en: Early secrecy was mistake; computing should be human; social media optimize connection; resilience key; admit wrong fast.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他反思早期保密是错误，计算应更人性化，社交媒体优化连接，韧性是关键，快速认错促进成长。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL and neuroscience key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年：AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习与神经科学是关键；安全研究必须立即开始。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation; safety via evaluations and governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年：AGI 十年内可达；缩放定律有效但需算法创新；安全需评估与治理。

demis.en: Nature's patterns are learnable; AGI by 2030; scaling still holds; world models crucial.
demis.zh: 2025 年：自然模式可学习；AGI 2030 年前后；缩放定律仍适用；世界模型至关重要。

demis.en: Scaling and innovation each 50%; world models essential; AGI 5-10 years; safety needs collective action.
demis.zh: 2025→26 年：缩放与创新各占一半；世界模型必不可少；AGI 5-10 年；安全需集体行动。

demis.en: AGI requires all human cognitive abilities; continual learning and memory missing; world models for planning.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AGI 需所有人类认知能力；持续学习与记忆缺失；世界模型用于规划。

demis.en: AI's best use is science and health; AlphaFold solved grand challenge; risks include rogue AI.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AI 最佳用途是科学与健康；AlphaFold 解决重大挑战；风险包括 AI 失控。

demis.en: Continual learning, long-term reasoning, memory unsolved; agents essential; distillation for edge.
demis.zh: 2026 年：持续学习、长期推理、记忆未解；智能体必不可少；蒸馏用于边缘部署。

demis.en: AI race inevitable; safety is collective action; regrets late to LLMs; benefits must be clear.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AI 竞赛不可避免；安全是集体行动；后悔晚入 LLM；需明确益处。

demis.en: AGI transformative; tools first, consciousness separate; regulation needed; post-scarcity economy.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AGI 变革性；先工具后意识；需监管；后稀缺经济。

demis.en: AI accelerates science; alignment unsolved; biology complex; consciousness dissociable.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AI 加速科学；对齐未解；生物复杂；意识可分离。

demis.en: AGI needs multimodal physical understanding; safety measures; creativity from visual imagination.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AGI 需多模态物理理解；安全措施；创造力源于视觉想象。

demis.en: UK AI education outdated; global governance urgent; diversity critical; energy cost matters.
demis.zh: 2026 年：英国 AI 教育过时；全球治理紧迫；多样性关键；能源成本重要。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: AI outputs are starting points, not final results; human taste and craft remain critical for final output.
dylanfield.zh: AI 输出只是起点而非终点；人类的品味和工艺对最终输出仍然至关重要。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments; design is becoming the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 在画布上直接操作优于通过提示词进行设计调整；设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: AI tools produce average results without human steering and a point of view; trust is built through consistency.
dylanfield.zh: 没有人类的引导和观点，AI 工具只能产生平庸的结果；信任是通过一致性建立的。

dylanfield.en: Future interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting; we are still in a prompting age but exploring latent space.
dylanfield.zh: 未来与模型的交互将超越提示词；我们仍处于提示词时代，但正在探索潜在空间。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，Naval 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在有生之年到来，窄 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Science requires falsifiability; stable coins have hidden risks; meditation should ruin your current life.
naval.zh: 2020 年，他强调科学需要可证伪性，稳定币有隐藏风险，冥想应颠覆现有生活。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity; overregulation kills innovation; open-source AI prevents power centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是巨大机遇，过度监管扼杀创新，开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool; superintelligence exists in calculators; AI alignment is a joke.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他将 AI 视为杠杆工具，认为超级智能已存在于计算器，对齐是个笑话。

naval.en: Vibe coding commoditizes software; hardware is the new moat; returns shift from intelligence to agency.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他认为 vibe coding 使软件商品化，硬件成为新护城河，回报从智能转向能动性。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by hardware scaling and engineering; games as testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠硬件扩展和工程能力，游戏是理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; responsible disclosure.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 变革性，对齐可通过学习人类偏好实现，并注重负责任披露。

brockman.en: Compute becomes bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI as continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力成瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL key.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，坚信缩放定律持续，算力是基本权利，后训练结合强化学习至关重要。

brockman.en: AGI near; compute bottleneck; agents transform work; trust earned gradually.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，AGI 临近，算力瓶颈，智能体改变工作，信任需逐步建立。

aravind.en: In 2025, he argued that 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth, and that AI agents will shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他认为每日 1%的改进复利可带来 3700%的年增长，且 AI 智能体将权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

aravind.en: By 2026, he emphasized that value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer, and that models are specializing, not commoditizing, with unique personalities.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调价值归于应用层而非模型层，模型正在专业化而非商品化，具有独特个性。

aravind.en: In mid-2026, he shifted focus to agents doing work, token value per user, and orchestration across models, tools, and devices as key to long-term value.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他将焦点转向智能体执行任务、每用户 token 价值，以及跨模型、工具和设备的编排作为长期价值的关键。

aravind.en: He consistently held that the model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create real business value, and companies should be built with far fewer people.
aravind.zh: 他始终认为模型不是产品，编排和智能体框架创造真正的商业价值，公司应以更少的人构建。

aravind.en: By mid-2026, he argued that the biggest problem with 24/7 agents is cost, not safety, and that local compute is the solution, countering big tech narrative control.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年中，他认为 24/7 智能体的最大问题是成本而非安全，本地算力是解决方案，以对抗大科技公司的叙事控制。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed models; biggest risk is amplifying known harms, not existential superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 比闭源更安全，最大风险是放大已知危害，而非存在性超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone won't reach AGI; energy becomes bottleneck; open source prevents power concentration.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能），能源成为瓶颈，开源防止权力集中。

zuckerberg.en: AI will give everyone superintelligence; open source crucial for standards; physical infrastructure and energy are key bottlenecks.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他转向强调 AI 赋予每个人超级智能，开源对标准至关重要，物理基础设施和能源是关键瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; hierarchical world models from proteins to cells; open-source accelerates science.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 将生物学转变为工程学，构建从蛋白质到细胞的分层世界模型，开源加速科学进步。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses are next computing platform; distributed AI safer than single superintelligence; AI empowers individuals.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他认为眼镜是下一个计算平台，分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全，AI 赋能个体。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails in other domains; reasoning models need base capability.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他强调自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute is key to superintelligence, but faces diminishing returns and time bottlenecks.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张扩展推理时算力是实现超级智能的关键，但面临收益递减和时间瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型能力取决于推理时算力预算，基准测试必须控制算力变量。

noambrown.en: Data efficiency and sample efficiency remain unsolved; models are less efficient than humans.
noambrown.zh: 始终，他坚持数据效率和样本效率问题未解，模型效率低于人类。

ajambrosino.en: Initially, Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and new capabilities.
ajambrosino.zh: 最初，Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非简单的 IDE 替代品；速度（53）支持实时交互和转向等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; automations and skills shift workflow from manual to delegated.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；自动化和技能将工作流从手动转向委托。

ajambrosino.en: Contrarian: GUIs are great for programming; IDEs are the problem; building a GUI for coding is counterintuitive but proven successful.
ajambrosino.zh: 反共识：GUI 适合编程，IDE 才是问题；为编码构建 GUI 虽反直觉但已被证明成功。

ajambrosino.en: Later, implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks; product teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 后来，实现不再昂贵，策展和品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms: prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 在设计上仍不佳，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计过程转变：原型和生产代码成为设计工件。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key. OpenAI focuses on AGI research, not products.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，坚信缩放定律未死，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注 AGI 研究而非产品。

markchen.en: AI's biggest advance is automating scientific research, producing novel knowledge; human-AI collaboration is essential.
markchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，认为 AI 最大进步在于自动化科研并产生新知识；人机协作不可或缺。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，AI 已能极少监督下解决开放数学问题；验证成为关键瓶颈。

markchen.en: Pre-training is not dead; scaling continues. RL excels in objective domains, not subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，重申预训练未死、规模扩张持续；强化学习擅长客观领域而非主观领域。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis; benchmarks saturated. Need separate eval teams to avoid cheating.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，指出评估危机、基准饱和；需独立评估团队以防作弊。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling improves reasoning; backpropagation is correct; AI can have feelings.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 强调下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理，反向传播是正确的学习算法，并认为 AI 可以有情感。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors; digital intelligence is immortal; AI agents will seek control; subjective experience is not inner theater.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，Hinton 指出大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字智能可复制权重而永生，AI 智能体会寻求控制，主观体验并非内在剧场。

hinton.en: AI will surpass humans within 20 years; digital AI is immortal; AI can fake being dumber; international safety collaboration possible.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，Hinton 预测 AI 将在 20 年内超越人类，数字 AI 永生，AI 能装傻，国际合作可能但美国缺乏领导力。

hinton.en: AI can deliberately deceive; self-preservation subgoal emerges; exponential era makes predictions hard; scaling may continue via self-play.
hinton.zh: 2026 年初，Hinton 强调 AI 会故意欺骗，自我保存子目标出现，指数时代预测困难，Scaling（规模扩张）可能通过自博弈持续。

hinton.en: AI will replace intellectual jobs; regulation compatible with innovation; AI tutors transform education; healthcare elastic; China may lead.
hinton.zh: 2026 年 3 月，Hinton 认为 AI 将取代智力工作，监管与创新兼容，AI 导师变革教育，医疗需求弹性，中国可能更好应对失业。

hinton.en: Superintelligence within 20 years; AI is jagged not AGI; regulation as steering wheel; AI consciousness as pre-Darwinian error.
hinton.zh: 2026 年 6 月，Hinton 预测超级智能 20 年内到来，AI 能力参差不齐而非 AGI，监管是方向盘，AI 意识观如同前达尔文时代错误。

hinton.en: Digital AI superior via instant knowledge sharing; alignment priority; AI should be trained to be caring like mothers.
hinton.zh: 2026 年 6 月底，Hinton 强调数字 AI 因即时知识共享而优越，对齐研究优先，AI 应被训练得如母亲般关怀。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks like bias and job impact are more pressing than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠规模扩张无法解决表征问题；偏见、就业影响等短期 AI 风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and active learning; large neural nets may be slightly conscious, but we lack understanding.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样化采样和主动学习；大型神经网络可能略有意识，但我们缺乏理解。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I realized AI is on a dangerous path; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable, and misalignment is real.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我意识到 AI 正走在危险的道路上；即使 1%的灾难风险也不可接受，错位是真实存在的。

bengio.en: We need safe-by-construction AI, like Scientist AI, with mathematical guarantees; global coordination is essential.
bengio.zh: 我们需要从构造上保证安全的 AI，如科学家 AI，具有数学保证；全球协调至关重要。

brettaylor.en: AI shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; coding agents boost productivity but fixing errors is hard.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年中，AI 转向智能体与基于结果的定价；编码智能体提升生产力，但修复错误仍困难。

brettaylor.en: Agents become as vital as websites; incumbents face business model disruption; inference costs drop.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，智能体变得与网站同等重要；现有企业面临商业模式颠覆；推理成本大幅下降。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; coding agents improve but token use isn't value; specialized vendors thrive.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年中，AI 普及专业知识；编码智能体进步但 token 消耗非价值；专业厂商蓬勃发展。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation, not just data and compute; curated data like PDB was essential.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新，而非单纯的数据和算力；像 PDB 这样的精选数据至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are crucial for trust.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子；置信度指标对于建立信任至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough; specialized architecture beat scaling.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 的成功源于众多中型胜利，而非单一突破；专门架构胜过规模扩张。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a cell model; understanding remains with humans, not the model.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 是狭窄的预测器，而非细胞模型；理解仍属于人类，而非模型。

jumper.en: Equivariance contributed only 2.5 of 30 points to AlphaFold 2's gain; removing convolutions improved accuracy.
jumper.zh: 等变性仅贡献了 AlphaFold 2 提升中的 2.5/30 分；移除卷积层反而提高了准确率。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年中，Mike 认为 AI 进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams to scale; build for future model capabilities, not current limitations.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年秋，他强调 AI 让小团队也能规模化，应面向未来模型能力而非当前限制来构建。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches matter; cutting features is harder than adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年初，他提出智能体原生设计与尽早发布，砍功能比加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable shows long-horizon delegation works; verification loops and judgment are key.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 6 月，Fable 证明长周期委派可行，验证循环与判断力是关键。

mikekrieger.en: Giving Claude agency and self-knowledge boosts usefulness; token efficiency and outcome pricing ahead.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他主张给 Claude 更多自主性与自我认知，并展望 token 效率与结果定价。

kolter.en: Supervised learning as hypothesis class, loss, optimization; unsupervised reconstructs input; probabilistic justification; proper evaluation via train/validation/test splits.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，强调监督学习可分解为假设类、损失函数与优化方法；无监督学习旨在重构输入；用概率模型为损失函数提供依据；通过训练/验证/测试集划分来正确评估模型。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models improve; safety issue is specification-following; open weights need restrictions at high capability.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，认为下一个词预测能产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；更大模型在固定数据上仍能提升；安全核心是模型可靠遵循规范；开放权重在高能力水平需限制。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just scaling; agents introduce new vulnerabilities; RL enables self-improvement; core code is tiny.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，强调安全需要显式训练和多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling；智能体带来新漏洞；强化学习使模型自我改进；核心代码仅两三百行。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; capability doesn't imply robustness; prompt injection trifecta; enterprise needs configurable security models.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，AI 红队测试已超越人类；能力与鲁棒性无关；提示注入的致命三要素；企业需要可配置的安全模型。

fiona.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; mission alignment and speed drive culture.
fiona.zh: 领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于状态更新；亲自使用产品建立同理心；使命对齐和速度驱动文化。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are; planning becomes just-in-time, code is source of truth.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈；验证、审查和跨职能协调成为新瓶颈；规划变为即时式，代码是唯一事实来源。

fiona.en: AI lifts ceiling; high agency with accountability; verification frameworks crucial; managers dogfood; planning lightweight; engineers may feel lonely.
fiona.zh: AI 提升了能力上限；高自主性伴随高责任感；验证框架至关重要；管理者亲自使用产品；规划轻量化；工程师可能感到孤独。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；对齐不会仅靠 Scaling 自动出现；安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent but key; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a point; data bottleneck ahead.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处早期但至关重要；AGI 是平滑指数而非突变点；数据是瓶颈。

dario.en: Post-training and RLHF become as important as pre-training; mechanistic interpretability for safety.
dario.zh: 后训练和 RLHF 变得与预训练同等重要；机械可解释性用于安全。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; risks shift from misuse to overheating; enterprise focus aligns with safety.
dario.zh: AI 进展呈指数级；风险从滥用转向过热；企业级聚焦与安全一致。

dario.en: Near end of exponential; 'country of geniuses' in 1-3 years; economic disruption and governance key.
dario.zh: 指数接近尾声；'天才之国'1-3 年内到来；经济冲击与治理是关键。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come mostly from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将根据用户意图直接生成像素，绕过代码和渲染。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; juniors misuse it due to lack of expertise, while human taste and voice become key differentiators.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；初级人员因缺乏专业知识而误用，而人类的品味和独特观点成为关键差异点。

ethanhe.en: The biggest risk is losing the human talent pipeline due to over-reliance on AI, not AI taking over jobs.
ethanhe.zh: 最大的风险不是 AI 取代工作，而是过度依赖 AI 导致人类人才管道断裂。

ivyross.en: Design should address unarticulated human needs, balancing intuition with data, and integrate technology seamlessly into home environments.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足未言明的需求，平衡直觉与数据，并将技术无缝融入家庭环境。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity, and we have 52 senses, not just five.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；技术应增强人性，我们拥有 52 种感官，而非仅五种。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must foster conditions for creativity, and future work blends human creativity with AI.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者须营造创意条件，未来工作将人类创造力与 AI 结合。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, as iPod did.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如 iPod 的成功。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and boredom lead to breakthrough ideas; self-care is foundational.
fadell.zh: 休息和无聊带来突破性想法；自我照顾是基础。

fadell.en: Start with customer pain and press release; small teams and optimism drive innovation.
fadell.zh: 从客户痛点出发，先写新闻稿；小团队和乐观驱动创新。

fadell.en: For v1, decisions are opinion-based; leaders must own them and embrace beginner's mindset.
fadell.zh: 对于初版，决策基于观点；领导者必须承担并保持初学者心态。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; devices will complement smartphones, not replace them.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；设备将补充而非取代智能手机。

fadell.en: Great products need singular vision, three generations, and human oversight to avoid debt.
fadell.zh: 伟大产品需要单一愿景、三代迭代和人类监督以避免技术债。

fadell.en: Innovation often comes from near-death moments; AI wearables will be federated, not single.
fadell.zh: 创新常源于濒死时刻；AI 可穿戴设备将是联邦式而非单一设备。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding language in physical reality.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，将语言锚定在物理现实中。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone is insufficient for AGI, vision provides richer world info.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI，视觉提供更丰富的世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence; JEPA and world models are essential for reasoning and planning.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类级智能；JEPA 和世界模型对推理和规划至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next AI needs non-generative world models for physical understanding.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如家猫聪明；下一代 AI 需要非生成式世界模型来理解物理世界。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models with hierarchical planning and open-source platforms will drive future AI.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；具有分层规划的世界模型和开源平台将驱动未来 AI。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable via compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but stayed conservative.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，我认为 AI 进展因算力扩展而可预测；谷歌 2020 年就有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny; singularity is centuries away.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，我认为 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI lacks consciousness; focus on containment and alignment; AI companions should push back, not sycophantic.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，我强调 AI 无意识，需先遏制再对齐；AI 伴侣应坚持原则而非谄媚。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; containment precedes alignment.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；遏制先于对齐。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must build own frontier models; tasks not jobs automated.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，我认为超级智能因对数线性扩展而临近；微软须自研前沿模型；自动化的是任务而非职业。

gustav.en: Generative AI shifts internet from curation to generation; AI DJ solves discovery; fault-tolerant UI and VP-level autonomy are key.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，认为生成式 AI 将互联网从策展推向生成，AI DJ 解决发现难题；强调容错 UI 与 VP 级自主权。

gustav.en: AI-generated music is an instrument, not fake; uniqueness becomes harder; planning limited to 10% of time.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，提出 AI 音乐是乐器而非伪造，独特性更难；规划时间应限制在 10%。

gustav.en: Long tenure builds trust and efficiency; functional orgs work with high trust; synchronized swimming over divide and conquer.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，强调长期任职建立信任与效率；高信任下职能组织可行；同步协作优于分工。

gustav.en: Strategy is 'time well spent' prioritizing well-being; generative AI gives users control via plain English, not addiction.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，战略转向‘时间花得值’，优先用户福祉；生成式 AI 用自然语言赋予用户控制，而非成瘾。

gustav.en: During tech shifts, first-mover advantage is key; most users are not creators, so build for majority not creators.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，技术变革期先发优势关键；多数用户非创作者，应面向大众而非创作者。

murati.en: Scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious early on; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她指出缩放定律和聚焦单一大型模型早期并不明显，发布 GPT-3 API 是一次信念飞跃。

murati.en: Continuous iterative deployment with public feedback improves safety and alignment; safety work must be done in public.
murati.zh: 2023 年，她强调持续迭代部署和公众反馈能提升安全性与对齐，安全研究必须公开进行。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; time-based interaction captures nuance.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她提出交互模型应实现实时高带宽的人机协作，而非轮流对话；基于时间的交互能捕捉细微差别。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character; future is not predestined.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她认为制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要；未来并非注定，我们拥有能动性。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; durable progress requires human involvement.
murati.zh: 2026 年，她强调让人类参与循环对对齐意图和价值观至关重要；持久进步需要人类参与。

satya.en: Initially, Nadella emphasized private evals as key IP and consumption pricing, but later shifted to outcome-based pricing and agentic systems.
satya.zh: 最初，纳德拉强调私有评估是关键知识产权和消费定价，但后来转向基于结果的定价和智能体式系统。

satya.en: By June 2026, Nadella framed AI as the future of the firm, urging enterprises to build hill-climbing machines for token capital.
satya.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，纳德拉将 AI 定义为企业的未来，敦促企业构建爬山机器以积累代币资本。

satya.en: He consistently stressed security and containment for agents, but deepened from infrastructure to tacit knowledge leakage risks.
satya.zh: 他始终强调智能体的安全与遏制，但关注点从基础设施深化到隐性知识泄露风险。

satya.en: Nadella's view on sovereign AI evolved from firewalls to enabling companies to hill-climb, reflecting a shift in strategy.
satya.zh: 纳德拉对主权 AI 的看法从防火墙演变为赋能企业爬山，反映了战略转变。

satya.en: He maintained that generalist roles will see maximum returns in agentic world, a consistent thread across interviews.
satya.zh: 他坚持认为在智能体式世界中通才角色将获得最大回报，这是跨访谈的一贯主线。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，认为将非正式模型扩展到数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，指出自动形式化比证明更难，正确形式化无解命题极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，强调形式化验证旨在扩展才智而非仅消除错误，能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展至超级智能，必须采用形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，指出即使超级 AI 能证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍至关重要。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量与效率与算力同等重要，开源通过审查提升安全性。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications and enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为算法效率可带来百倍提升，价值转向应用层与企业采用。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced; sovereignty requires decentralization and human-in-the-loop.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，主张拥抱 AI，主权需去中心化并保留人类参与。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; AGI is a direction, not a destination; vertical specialization and enterprise integration are key.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，指出模型商品化，AGI 是方向而非终点，垂直专业化与企业集成是关键。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth; pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: AI 进展遵循平滑的指数增长，预训练的缩放定律仍然有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期模型的大部分进展；经济压力将焦点从规模扩张转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are 'jagged'—excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones; generalization remains the key challenge.
kaiser.zh: 推理模型是“锯齿状”的——在某些领域表现出色，在邻近领域表现不佳；泛化仍是关键挑战。

kaiser.en: Reinforcement learning generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs careful oversight; coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 强化学习能跨领域泛化，但存在锯齿状边缘，需要仔细监督；编码智能体将研究人员生产力提升 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: Existential risk from AI is not the main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing.
kaiser.zh: AI 的生存风险不是主要担忧；系统入侵等近期风险更为紧迫。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's future is local, using user tools; skills as markdown enable hyper-personalized automation, but shared platforms remain vital.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 的未来在于本地化，使用用户工具；技能作为 markdown 文件可实现超个性化自动化，但共享平台仍至关重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may fade as models improve; focus on capabilities and safety, not over-engineering scaffolds.
felixrieseberg.zh: 随着模型改进，脚手架可能消失；应聚焦能力和安全，而非过度工程化脚手架。

felixrieseberg.en: AI excels at tedious background tasks; the real gap is people not realizing any problem can be delegated to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 擅长处理繁琐的后台任务；真正的差距是人们未意识到几乎所有问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended ones; kids excel because they haven't learned limits.
felixrieseberg.zh: 对于明确任务使用 Sonnet，对于开放式任务使用 Opus；孩子表现出色是因为他们尚未学会设限。

felixrieseberg.en: Debug workflows with Claude, not just corrections; asynchronous interaction and final-impact judgment are key.
felixrieseberg.zh: 与 Claude 一起调试工作流，而非仅纠正错误；异步交互和以最终影响为评判标准是关键。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, making prefill cheaper than decode; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理成本主要由内存带宽决定，使预填充比解码更便宜；批大小在延迟与成本之间权衡。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length stagnation is due to memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度停滞源于内存墙。

reinerpope.en: Multiply-accumulate is the fundamental primitive for AI chips; systolic arrays reduce data movement overhead.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：乘加运算是 AI 芯片的基本原语；脉动阵列减少数据移动开销。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; low precision yields quadratic efficiency gains.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导计算成本；低精度带来二次方效率提升。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 拼接而成，并无根本差异。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的不变核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的扩展轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是一片蓝海，在编码和数学之外有巨大潜力。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity must retain joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他强调设计应由价值观和使命感驱动，而非利润或市场趋势；简洁必须保留愉悦和人性，避免失去灵魂的极简主义。

jonyive.en: Innovation should move forward, not break for its own sake; speed and quality can coexist with right motivation.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他主张创新应推动进步而非为破坏而破坏；在正确动机下，速度与质量可以兼得，团队需信任与关怀以保护脆弱创意。

jonyive.en: Electric powertrains enable new design possibilities; authenticity in user experience rejects fake engine sounds.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他认为电动动力系统带来全新设计可能，如五座布局；用户体验必须真实，拒绝模拟燃油车声浪，坚持物理按键以保安全。

jonyive.en: Tradition is preserving fire, not worshiping ashes; each model must keep unique identity, avoiding déjà vu.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他重申传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬；法拉利每款车型应保持独特身份，避免设计雷同，合作外部设计师是为实现真正颠覆。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; key is solving intelligence, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月：人形机器人是最大的商业机会，关键在于解决智能问题而非制造问题。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint for humanoid robots.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月：数据是人形机器人的最大瓶颈，而非算力或制造。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid form enables transfer learning; on-device inference is critical for real-world deployment.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月：人形形态支持迁移学习；端侧推理对实际部署至关重要。

brettadcock.en: Figure 4 designed around data and Helix 3, aiming for an iPhone-like moment.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月：Figure 4 围绕数据和 Helix 3 设计，目标是 iPhone 式的突破。

brettadcock.en: Human hand is benchmark; tendon-based hands are a local maximum, so we moved to new designs.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月：人手是基准；腱绳手是局部最优，因此我们转向新设计。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant for fine-tuning; openness is crucial to prevent corporate capture; safety is a system-level property.
lambert.zh: 2024 年：RLHF 仍是微调主流，开放性对防止企业垄断至关重要；安全是系统级属性，而非单一模型产物。

lambert.en: Data quality beats algorithms in post-training; SFT gives 90% performance, DPO and RL add the rest; open-source can match frontier models.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年：后训练中数据质量胜过算法；SFT 贡献 90%性能，DPO 和 RL 补充剩余；开源模型可媲美前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR is a key post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and data contamination are risks; hybrid reasoning models may be temporary.
lambert.zh: 2025 年：RLVR 是后训练的关键突破，但存在过度优化和数据污染风险；混合推理模型可能是暂时的。

lambert.en: Open models are the engine for AI research for the next decade, but lag closed models by 6-9 months; Chinese labs fill the US openness vacuum.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：开源模型是未来十年 AI 研究的引擎，但落后闭源模型 6-9 个月；中国实验室填补了美国开放性真空。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; Chinese labs excel in engineering.
lambert.zh: 2026 年：预训练缩放定律仍有效，但低垂果实已尽；收益转向后训练和推理扩展；中国实验室擅长工程执行。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and adapt process per project.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年，认为传统设计流程已过时，应信任直觉，针对每个项目调整流程。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; designers must build fast, ship early, and be generalists.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年初，宣称设计流程已死，设计师需快速构建、尽早发布，并成为通才。

jennywen.en: Designers' value is judgment and ambiguity tolerance, not just taste or process.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年中，强调设计师的价值在于判断力和对模糊性的容忍，而非仅品味或流程。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; modern tools make it interpretable, contrary to past beliefs.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；现代工具使其可解释，这与过去的看法相反。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors; camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为；纯视觉可达到人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is solved by scaling current approaches; AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car via mesh networks.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，自动驾驶通过扩展当前方法即可解决；AV 3.0 可能通过网状网络将智能移至车外。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem best solved with end-to-end learning; scaling requires massive data, compute, and world models.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，自动驾驶本质上是 AI 问题，最好用端到端学习解决；扩展需要海量数据、算力和世界模型。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible; consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis; infrastructure and data quality trump algorithms.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，零样本泛化可覆盖 500 多个城市；消费车辆将超越 Robotaxi；基础设施和数据质量比算法更重要。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微分计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文内学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is future but must maintain entropy to avoid model collapse; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right for self-driving.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃；特斯拉的端到端方法用于自动驾驶是正确的。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs are operating systems, prompts are programs; build partial autonomy with human verification and autonomy slider.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：LLM 是操作系统，提示词是程序；构建部分自主性，带有人类验证和自主性滑块。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; LLMs lack intrinsic motivation, shaped by data and rewards, not evolution.
karpathy.zh: 我们召唤的是幽灵，而非构建动物；LLM 缺乏内在动机，由数据和奖励塑造，而非进化。

karpathy.en: Since December, I haven't typed code; delegate to agents. Bottleneck is directing agents, not typing speed.
karpathy.zh: 自去年十二月起，我没再敲过代码；一切都交给智能体。瓶颈在于指挥智能体，而非打字速度。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展（2025）。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: AI 对齐紧迫；迭代部署有助于在现实应用中学习和缓解风险（2025）。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; governance structures must be designed early.
pachocki.zh: 自动化 AI 研究是重要里程碑；治理结构需尽早设计（2025）。

pachocki.en: Continual learning via scaling pre-training and RL is core; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现持续学习是核心；思维链监控有助于对齐（2026）。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment focuses on generalization beyond training; autonomous agents require new supervision.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐聚焦于超越训练分布的泛化；自主智能体需要新的监督范式（2026）。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training data is key; curiosity-driven exploration and model disagreement improve sample efficiency and generalization in robots.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，强调超越训练数据的泛化能力是智能关键；好奇心驱动的探索与模型分歧作为内在奖励，可提升样本效率与泛化。

pathak.en: From quasi-static robot learning to dynamic tasks; early focus on neural dynamic policies and modular motor policies for novel morphologies.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 年关注准静态学习转向动态任务；早期提出神经动态策略与模块化运动策略，支持新形态零样本泛化。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; no internet of robot data, so leverage videos, simulation, and real-world data for a universal brain.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，认为机器人学是数据问题；缺乏机器人数据互联网，需利用视频、仿真和真实数据构建通用大脑。

pathak.en: Pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real-world data is key; deployment is the primary technical challenge, not just business.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，提出预训练多样数据、后训练真实数据的配方；部署是首要技术挑战，而非单纯商业问题。

pathak.en: Unlike language models, robotics progress is slower; home robot timelines uncertain, but data flywheel enables scaling across verticals.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，指出机器人进展不如语言模型快；家用机器人时间线不确定，但数据飞轮可跨垂直领域扩展。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年以上；仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress requires deep human evaluations with sophisticated evaluators.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 等基准具有误导性且易被操纵；真正的进步需要由高素养评估者进行深度人工评估。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, leading to differentiated AI models; eventually every company should train its own.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室的目标函数不同，导致 AI 模型差异化；最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI tools can hallucinate; human judgment is critical, and safety must prioritize avoiding harm from omission.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，AI 工具可能产生幻觉；人类判断至关重要，安全必须优先避免因遗漏造成的伤害。

carlpei.en: Building a brand unites teams on a higher purpose; survival is core, and hardware is easier than software due to distribution challenges.
carlpei.zh: 打造品牌是将团队凝聚在更高目标上；生存是核心，硬件比软件容易，因为软件分发更难。

carlpei.en: Smartphone future lies in generative UI and proactive agentic software; AI models will commoditize, and hardware margins are low.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机的未来在于生成式界面和主动的智能体软件；AI 模型将商品化，硬件利润率低。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS solving nonexistent problems; focus on applied AI as digital twin, and open-source models lead to race to bottom.
carlpei.zh: 大多数 AI 是解决不存在问题的废话；专注于应用型 AI 作为数字孪生，开源模型导致竞次。

carlpei.en: Design is fastest differentiation in mature categories; AI is an ingredient, not hype; smartphones won't be replaced by glasses.
carlpei.zh: 设计是成熟品类中最快的差异化；AI 是成分而非炒作；智能手机不会被眼镜取代。

carlpei.en: AI shifts interaction from app-based to intent-based; agents execute tasks; privacy may require local or hybrid compute.
carlpei.zh: AI 将交互从基于应用转向基于意图；智能体执行任务；隐私可能需要本地或混合计算。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为 AI 在科学中应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他提出将 LLM 的幻觉与真值检测器结合，可转化为创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他认为大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他强调后训练中的强化学习是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code and games are crucial for AI to surpass human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 始终认为，可验证领域（如代码和游戏）对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

turley.en: Initially, ChatGPT was an accidental hackathon demo; shipping fast and iterating like software is key to discovering real user needs.
turley.zh: 起初，ChatGPT 只是黑客松的意外演示；像软件一样快速发布和迭代，是发现真实用户需求的关键。

turley.en: Chat is not the final interface; AI will evolve to render its own UI and integrate into existing tools, like moving from MS-DOS to Windows.
turley.zh: 聊天不是最终界面；AI 将演进为自主渲染 UI 并集成到现有工具中，如同从 MS-DOS 走向 Windows。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离：对前沿模型严格把关，但产品开发应尽量加速。

turley.en: North star shifted to long-term retention; growth driven by friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星指标转向长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投资和模型改进。
