turley.en: Next billion users require proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、高交互产品；推理模型在无缝产品化后具有变革性。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI knowledge and reducing hallucinations; LLMs lack grounded experience.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，强调具身对 AI 知识落地和减少幻觉至关重要，LLM 因缺乏具身经验而产生幻觉。

jimfan.en: Simulation is key for training embodied agents, providing infinite data and safe exploration.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，提出模拟是训练具身智能体的关键，能提供无限数据和安全探索。

jimfan.en: Data bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，指出机器人领域数据瓶颈，合成数据（通过模拟和世界模型）是规模化的未来。

jimfan.en: Physical Turing test (robot cleaning messy house) is grand challenge; programmable factories and wet labs are near-term.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，提出物理图灵测试（机器人打扫乱房）是重大挑战，可编程工厂和湿实验室是近期应用。

jimfan.en: Intelligent robots will exceed iPhones by 2040; system one (low-level control) remains hardest.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，预测智能机器人数量 2040 年超 iPhone；系统一（低级控制）仍是最难部分。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，认为 AI 应像显微镜和望远镜一样扩展人类能力，从视频学习和通用智能体（如 Gato）是通向 AGI 的可行路径。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogs legacy issues; AI safety is the biggest open challenge; human skills matter as much as coding.
nando.zh: 2026 年，强调非洲在 AI 领域具有跳跃式发展的独特优势，AI 安全是最大的未解难题，沟通等人际技能与编程同等重要。

nando.en: AI should benefit all humanity, with diversity and inclusion essential for building beneficial technology.
nando.zh: 始终认为 AI 应造福全人类，多样性和包容性对于构建有益技术至关重要。

nando.en: From excitement about scaling and generalist agents to a focus on safety, responsibility, and real-world deployment.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年对规模扩张和通用智能体的兴奋，转向 2026 年对安全、负责任部署和实际应用的关注。

nando.en: Emphasis on learning from diverse data sources (video, local languages) and embracing failure in research.
nando.zh: 始终强调从多样化数据源（如视频、本地语言）学习，并在研究中拥抱失败。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence dramatically.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估了；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能大幅提升模型智能。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new breakthroughs.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调强化学习是新的扩展轴；预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，无需新突破。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, not capability, is the main bottleneck; coding leads AI progress due to verifiability.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为智能体的可靠性而非能力是主要瓶颈；编码因可验证性而引领 AI 进步。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential; transformers are sufficient for AGI; robotics lags due to data and feedback loops.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我坚信进展是指数级的；Transformer 足以实现 AGI；机器人技术因数据和反馈循环而滞后。

sholto.en: Capability overhang dominates; managing agent teams and compute supply are key; world models not critical for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为能力过剩是主导；管理智能体团队和算力供应是关键；世界模型对 AGI 并非关键路径。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；拥有更好数据和算法的较小模型可以超越较大模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training on internet data gives broad knowledge but lacks common sense; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety.
yejin.zh: 2023 年至 2025 年，我持续强调预训练提供广泛知识但缺乏常识，后训练（如 RLHF）对安全至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我指出数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning, especially during pre-training, improves reasoning and yields lasting gains despite compute cost.
yejin.zh: 2025 年至 2026 年，我主张强化学习（尤其在预训练阶段）能提升推理能力，尽管算力成本高，但收益持久。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; small models with diverse synthetic data can match frontier models.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我倡导多元对齐以尊重人类价值观多样性；通过多样化合成数据，小模型可媲美前沿模型。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈，通过引导工程师并聚焦问题对齐来推动工作。

nadchishtie.en: Treat AI as a creative partner; jam with it openly without rigid structure.
nadchishtie.zh: 将 AI 视为创意伙伴，以开放、无固定结构的方式与之协作。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是互操作的，代码将成为唯一事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable.
nadchishtie.zh: 能够端到端执行并利用 AI 填补空白的通才型设计师最具价值。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为常态；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over innovation in interaction design.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，强调设计师应会编程以建立同理心并加快交付；优先追求速度和熟悉度，而非交互设计上的创新。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines should be dynamic, not static.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为初创公司的品牌策略应聚焦招聘和差异化；品牌指南应是动态平台，而非静态规则。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate its role in winning, and brand narrative attracts top talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，将设计视为战略武器，创始人需阐明其制胜作用；品牌叙事成为吸引顶尖人才的关键。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; avoid structured crits, prefer organic feedback to maintain velocity and autonomy.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多元原型而非克隆；避免结构化评审，偏好有机反馈以保持速度和自主性。

henrymodisett.en: In fast-growing startups, gut decisions often beat data-driven ones; adapt process to problem, not universal template.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，认为在快速成长的初创公司，直觉决策常优于数据驱动；流程应适应问题，而非套用通用模板。

truell.en: Scaling laws drive predictable AI progress; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as next major driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我强调缩放定律带来可预测的 AI 进步，并认为测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are often better.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我提出自然语言不会成为主要编程方式，示例和直接操作往往更优。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我认为智能体有前景但尚不实用，迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification; taste and logic design become more valuable.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我主张编程将从代码转向更高层次的意图描述，品味和逻辑设计能力将更有价值。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost; every magic moment involves one.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我强调定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其在速度和成本上；每个神奇时刻都离不开定制模型。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research is under-explored. Focus on alignment, robustness, and skill-building.
leike.zh: 2018 年，强调 AI 安全至关重要，实证研究尚待开发，应聚焦对齐与鲁棒性，并注重技能培养。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年，认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需可扩展监督与可解释性；对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient. Need external oversight and third-party testing.
leike.zh: 2024 年，指出 OpenAI 安全文化退化，后训练不足以解决对齐，需外部监管与第三方测试。

shazeer.en: Scaling with more compute and data makes LLMs smarter, but we don't understand their inner workings.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为通过更多算力和数据扩展能让大语言模型更聪明，但我们对模型内部运作的理解仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are key near-term opportunities for model improvement.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他强调推理时算力扩展和更长上下文窗口是近期提升模型能力的关键机会。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data; continual learning with modular components could replace retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察数据；模块化组件的持续学习可能取代整体重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and RL are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为测试时算力扩展推动进步，但仅靠它无法实现 AGI；智能体能力和强化学习至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; its economic impact will be enormous, and coding is underhyped for AI self-acceleration.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 被低估，其经济影响将远超万亿美元产品；编码作为 AI 自我加速的应用也被低估。

abbeel.en: Self-play and imitation learning are powerful for robot skill acquisition; RL needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，强调自博弈和模仿学习对机器人技能获取的强大作用，并指出强化学习需要分层推理以解决长时程任务。

abbeel.en: Shift from emphasizing self-play and imitation to combining unsupervised learning with RL for sample efficiency in robotics.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 年强调自博弈和模仿学习，到 2021 年转向结合无监督学习与强化学习以提升机器人样本效率。

abbeel.en: Prior knowledge should be used for data generation, not hard-coded; hard-coding limits performance.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，主张先验知识应用于数据生成而非硬编码，硬编码会限制性能。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models transfer reasoning to non-language tasks; minimal adaptation enables image classification and protein binding.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，发现预训练语言模型可迁移推理到非语言任务，最小适配即可完成图像分类和蛋白质结合预测。

abbeel.en: Consistent focus on RL and robotics, with evolving views on learning signals and transfer.
abbeel.zh: 始终关注强化学习与机器人，但对学习信号和迁移的观点不断深化。
